spec_match.rationale: The subgroup built-in table (broadcast/add/all/any/elect/shuffle with per-argument uniformity requirements) and the strict-vs-relaxed before/after WGSL comparison accurately reflect the gpuweb subgroups + subgroup_uniformity changes, including the safety trade-off note.

interactive.rationale: Only the generic bolted-on 'scenario focus' walkthrough (scroll+highlight) — no live probe, although wgslLanguageFeatures.has('subgroup_uniformity') is trivially probeable from any page.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises the built-in list, what uniformity means, and which patterns the extension enables; delivered faithfully.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the opts-out-of-safety caveat, but no capability/version detection contextualises the reference for the visitor's browser.

conformance.rationale: Covered by the targeted feature suite; the reference content matches the surfaces the suite asserts.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Load verified with screenshots and clean console on both viewports; as a static reference there was no feature control to drive.

telemetry_health.rationale: Server-injected /public/demo-telemetry.js verified in the served DOM.

design_system.rationale: Shared variables for the table and code comparison; readable hierarchy.

accessibility.rationale: Semantic table with headers, aria-labelledby walkthrough section, and an aria-live walkthrough output.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-measured at 360px: the fn-table reaches 392px, so its right edge (the uniformity column) is clipped by body overflow-x:hidden.

openQuestions.title: Add a live wgslLanguageFeatures probe
openQuestions.detail: A one-line check of navigator.gpu?.wgslLanguageFeatures.has('subgroup_uniformity') would turn this static reference into a contextual one ('your browser advertises/does not advertise this extension') at almost no cost, satisfying the no-static-card bar with the exact spec surface.

openQuestions.title: Make the built-ins table scroll on mobile
openQuestions.detail: At 360px the table measures 392px and the 'Uniformity affected' column is partially cut; wrap it in an overflow-x:auto container.

summary: Accurate and well-organised reference for the subgroup built-ins and what the relaxed analysis permits, with good a11y semantics; it wants a trivial live wgslLanguageFeatures probe to escape static-card territory and an overflow wrapper for its table at 360px. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshot + DOM dump) and raw CDP (real click dispatch, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile emulation) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so v145-only API paths were validated on their fallback branches, not the new-API success path. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental (blocked host) and was not counted against any page.
